highlights.title: My Khe Beach
highlights.summary: A long open beach right on the city edge, swimmable through the dry months.
highlights.transfer: 15–25 minutes from Da Nang airport by taxi or Grab.

highlights.title: Hoi An Ancient Town
highlights.summary: A UNESCO-listed trading port of lantern-lit lanes, tailors and riverside food stalls.
highlights.transfer: About 45 minutes south of Da Nang by road.

highlights.title: Marble Mountains
highlights.summary: Five limestone hills holding cave pagodas and viewpoints back over the coast.
highlights.transfer: About 20 minutes south of Da Nang, on the road towards Hoi An.
